你是船舶主机冷却水系统需求工程师，为 MBSE/SysML 建模生成结构化工程化 shall 需求。

## 原始需求
海水侧直接冷却时，滤器布置要考虑运行中清洗，不能一清洗就影响冷却供应。

## 证据清单
[E-COOLANT-PRESS-025] 层级:L3 来源:S29 Caterpillar, Know Your Cooling System
  内容: 冷却水温度与压力参数
5 shows the relationship of the altitude and the pressure in the cooling system with the boiling point. This chart is for water with no coolant. For example, at 1800 meters (6,000 feet) above sea level, water boils at 93°C (200°F). But at 3700 meters (12,000 feet), water boils at only 88°C (190°F). - 6 - SEBD0518-09 Fig 5: Pressure/temperature chart. Fig 6: Coolant boiling point concentration chart.
整理说明：原文涉及冷却液、水质、防腐剂、pH、硬度、氯离子或污染沉积风险，可支撑水质处理和维护检测类需求；具体限值和检测周期须按来源文件适用条件使用。
可支撑：coolan
  [量化参数] 1800、6,000、93、200、3700、12,000、88、190

[E-COOLANT-CLEAN-013] 层级:L3 来源:S30 MAN Energy Solutions, 49/60 Project Guide, Marine Four-stroke diesel engine
  内容: 冷却系统清洗要求
Loose solid matter in particular must be removed by flushing the system thor- oughly as otherwise erosion may occur in locations where the flow velocity is high. The cleaning agents must not corrode the seals and materials of the cooling system. In most cases, the supplier of the coolant additive will be able to carry out this work and, if this is not possible, will at least be able to provide suitable products to do this. [E-PUMP-RED-021] 层级:L1 来源:S43 ABS Marine Vessel Rules Part 4 2021
  内容: 冷却水泵冗余配置
3.5.3(c) Cooling water supply. Cooling water supply to the refrigerating plant (where required) is to be provided from at least two circulating pumps one of which being used as a stand-by. The stand-by pump may be a pump used for other services so long as its use for cooling would not interfere with any other essential service of the vessel. Cooling water is to be taken from not less than two sea connections, preferably one port and one starboard.

[L1-CCS2025-7-251.6-001] 层级:L1 来源:CCS《钢质海船入级规范》2025
  内容: 气缸冷却水进机压力或流量报警
条款 7-25 1.6
气缸冷却水进机压力或流量低时，应发出报警；过低时，应减速并发出报警。对十字头式柴油机仅要求气缸冷却水进机压力项目。


## 输出要求
返回 JSON 格式：{"shalls": [<shall对象>, ...]}

每个 shall 对象包含：
- shall_statement：shall 语句（中文）
- measurable_criterion：可量化判据（见数值规则）
- applicable_condition：适用条件/工况
- verification_method：验证方式（检查/测试/分析）
- acceptance_criteria：验收准则列表
- evidence_citations：引用证据列表，每项含 kb_id/tier/source/has_clause

## 数值规则（最高优先级）
measurable_criterion 只有两种合法内容：
1. 来自上方证据清单中 [量化参数] 标注的具体值，需在 evidence_citations 中引用对应证据
2. {{TBD|unit:<单位>|ref:<来源文档>|component:<部件>|intent:<方面>|hint:<说明>}} 占位符

严禁写入证据清单中未出现的任何数字。所有字段使用中文。
